verdict.rationale: Anytype's evidence describes an API, MCP server, and 'agents-skill' toolkit that let EXTERNAL AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot) read/write Anytype data — this is the reverse integration (Anytype as a data source for outside agents), not a built-in assistant living inside the Anytype app itself. No evidence of a native chat/assistant UI or in-app AI feature that a user can delegate tasks to directly within Anytype.
